title: AN2 Therapeutics Reports Positive Enabling Data Supporting Advancement of Oral AN2-502998 to Phase 2 Study for Chronic Chagas Disease
summary: MENLO PARK, Calif., June 04, 2026--AN2 Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: ANTX) a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel small molecule therapeutics derived from its boron chemistry platform, today announced positive results from two studies evaluating the Company’s oral CPSF3 inhibitor, AN2-502998, for the treatment of chronic Chagas disease (American trypanosomiasis) caused by infection with the parasite T. cruzi.
